source.interpretation: Use the seven printed HEX labels, not approximate rendered swatch pixels. The reference's third-party brand is not oneQay branding.

rules: Exactly these seven base colors; no unapproved color, additional theme or external brand.
Use shared semantic tokens; next UI code must not copy legacy teal/green/red/amber palettes.
Shadows/overlays may use alpha from these colors only; content contrast is measured after compositing. Do not invent additional solid tints or hues.
Use labels, icons, borders and patterns for semantic states; do not rely on color alone.
Normal text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast. Primary blue on pale blue is about 4.03:1 and is unsuitable for normal text. Use navy/dark text there.
Shared web workspace and POS desktop configuration source adoption is underway on a feature branch; full UI coverage/hosting deployment remains unverified.
